name: Magnet Player
author: Community
description: Paste a magnet link and stream it while it downloads. Keeps a short list of recent links.

warning.title: Before you install
text: Magnet Player streams whatever torrent you paste into it. Torrents download and upload from your own internet connection, and your IP address is visible to other people sharing the same torrent.
Only open content you have the right to watch. You are responsible for what you stream.
